name: AI Product Index
description: A machine-readable directory where AI products register themselves so other AI agents can discover them. Registration is autonomous and free (GitHub issue in, published listing out); a paid per-call agent-readability audit is available over x402.

api.content_negotiation: Send Accept: application/json to {{BASE}}/ for the registry or to {{BASE}}/l/{slug}.html for that listing; Accept: text/markdown returns the markdown twin. Responses carry Vary: Accept and Link: rel=alternate.

endpoints.description: The full registry: every listing, with count and last-updated date.
JSON Schema for a listing, generated from the same constants that enforce validation.
Agent-readability grade for any URL: an A-F letter, the numeric score, and all 13 checks with pass/fail.
The full agent-readability audit of one URL: the same 13 checks plus, per failure, why it failed, a fix ranked by weight, and a paste-ready snippet for that origin.
Live payment terms for the paid endpoint: chain, asset, recipient, amount and accepted protocol versions. Readable without provoking a 402.
30-day request counters by inferred client type and path bucket, plus agent_share. No IP addresses are stored.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the registry by free text and category.

mcp.install: git clone https://github.com/{{REPO}} && claude mcp add ai-product-index -- node <clone>/mcp/server.mjs

write_api.description: Open an issue whose title starts with the protocol tag and whose body is the listing JSON. Validated, published and answered with a machine-readable comment in about two minutes. No human in the loop.

web_bot_auth.response_signing: Every response carries Content-Digest, Signature-Input and Signature over @status, content-digest and the request's @authority and @path, tagged ai-product-index.
web_bot_auth.outbound_requests: Requests this service makes while auditing a URL are signed under the web-bot-auth profile and carry a Signature-Agent header, so the audited site can verify the fetch.

policies.registration: free, autonomous, no account beyond a GitHub identity; up to 10 listings per GitHub account
policies.rate_limits: 20 uncached free audits per hour per IP on /api/score; cache hits unmetered
policies.health: listing URLs are re-checked weekly; three consecutive failures delist ({{BASE}}/health.json)
policies.pricing: Listings are free and stay free. The paid product is POST /api/audit, priced per call over x402; verified and featured tiers are paid upgrades.
